t: Feeding the Beast: Why I Turned Off Privacy Mode to Teach AI My Niche Framework
s: The author disables AI privacy mode to train assistants on their niche FastHTML framework, addressing the AI knowledge gap and refactoring their Pipulate project and blog for better structure and AI integration.
sub: AI training data privacy vs. AI capability for niche frameworks
Refactoring Pipulate project and blog with the 'Rule of 7' for structure
Navigating AI limitations (context windows, outdated training data) for development
The 'magic rolling pin' metaphor for continuous codebase improvement
SEO evolution and content generation in the age of AI
